answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Each submission hangs on the lotus of a task receipt, and the dawn is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the beacon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, converted to a slow vesting stream, rewards vest against future work.
